conviction_note: The FY and H1 guidance was already raised on 2026-09-16 (H1 OP 850 to 1,400m yen; the stock rose 7.5% the next day), so this release adds only the Q1 number. The company has guided conservatively and then raised for two years running, and last year's Q1, printed after an identical September raise, came in at 61.7% of the revised H1 and was bought. That gives a small positive lean (p_up 56) on a 3.3% scale. Against it: a crowded margin long (信用倍率 18.4, about ten days of volume) and a 10.75% run-up. impact_sum +0.6 and impact_scaled +0.40 agree in sign and are close in size.
bar: There is no sell-side consensus (kabuyoho shows no コンセンサス: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3321). The bar is the company's revised H1 guide of OP 1,400m / ordinary profit 1,600m yen from 2026-09-16 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916537160.pdf). print_vs_bar is Q1 OP against half of that guide (700m). That bar is my construction, not a market number, so every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.52% of shares, 2 sellers, up 0.06pt (building slightly), as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 18.41 on 09-25: margin long 255.9k shares against 13.9k short. That is about 3.2% of the 7.97m shares outstanding and roughly ten days of the ~24k shares/day turnover (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3321). Margin longs have stayed at 233-270k since late August. There is no option market and so no skew. The baseline's priced_lean is -0.38.

findings.finding: The Q1 OP is likely to show a high progress rate against the revised H1 guide of 1,400m yen. That guide sits 11% below last year's actual H1 of 1,573m, and Q2 is the seasonally larger quarter (last year Q1 709 / Q2 864). The company's record is to guide conservatively and raise repeatedly: FY26 OP went 2,000 to 2,250 to 2,450 to 2,700 and finished at 2,763, and FY25 went 1,800 to 2,148. The Q1 print itself has never carried a revision. Last year's Q1, printed after the same September pre-raise, was 61.7% of the revised H1 and drew 'さらなる上振れ期待' coverage.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-03 Q1 (15:30): OP 709m, 2.8x YoY, 61.7% of the revised H1. The stock closed +110 yen (+7.0%) to 1,685 on 10-06, a 7-year-8-month high. That session was also the Takaichi rally day, so part of the move was market-wide (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3321&b=n202510060927). In the baseline, the estimated 2025-10-06 reaction is +6.98.
findings.why_not_priced: The H1 and FY raise is priced: +7.5% on 9/17, and the stock has drifted from 1,810 to about 1,900 since. The Q1 number itself is not public. If the market already expected a Q1 well above half of H1, the stock would have gone on re-rating past the 9/17 jump on the same news rather than drifting about 5%. It still trades on 8.0x revised PER. The inference is that the company knew Q1 when it set H1 at 1,400, and that a guide below last year's H1 implies a light Q2 rather than a weak Q1. That is an inference, so the size is small.
findings.independence: The revision PDF (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916537160.pdf) gives the guide against last year's H1 actual. The 2025 analogue is a separate source (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3321&b=n202510060927). Both rest on the company's own guidance habit.

findings.finding: The FY27 plan assumes USD at ¥150 (FY 短信, 2026-07-06), while spot sits around ¥158. That helps a trader with a USD-linked semiconductor book and an overseas EMS segment, and it shows up mainly in non-operating FX gains and in translation of the overseas segment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior FX-specific surprise found for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission, so it is a hypothesis. The 9/16 revision gives only autos and EMS orders as reasons and does not mention FX, so part of it may already be in the revised numbers or still to come at the ordinary-profit line. Small.
findings.independence: The kabutan header shows USD/JPY at 158.03 on 2026-10-02 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3321).

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is crowded long into the print. The 信用倍率 is 18.4, with margin long of 255.9k shares, about ten days of turnover, after a 10.75% 20-day run-up mostly made on the 9/17 revision jump. Disclosed shorts are building slightly (1.46% to 1.52%). That gives a good Q1 some sellers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction measured. Margin long was similar into last year's Q1 and the stock still rose (single, confounded case).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the baseline's margin_overhang component (-0.63) already carries it. It is filed because it is a sourced fact bearing on the window. It argues against a positive Q1 reading the 'sell the news' way, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The baseline's JPX short register (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html) shows shorts building +0.06pt.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-25 Mitachi renewed its ¥15bn commitment line and drew ¥5.3bn for one month for working capital. Asked what the money buys: the 9/16 revision cites strong EMS orders and autos, inventory rose ¥2.6bn last FY, and the same kind of draw came beside last year's September raise. It reads as funding a ramp, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A similar commitment-line draw was announced on 2025-09-19 beside the raise. The stock rose afterwards; no separate reaction can be measured.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a corroborating detail. The company calls the impact 軽微, so it adds little on its own.
findings.independence: The 9/16 revision PDF names EMS order strength (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260916/140120260916537160.pdf). Same company documents.

findings.finding: Dividend policy is a ~30% consolidated payout. Revised EPS of 238.36 implies about 71.5 yen against the held 70 yen plan, so the dividend now sits slightly below policy. A raise at Q1 is unlikely: last year's 10-yen raise came with the November revision, not at Q1. Small optionality.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-11-21: an H1 and FY raise plus a 10-yen dividend raise. The stock 'rebounded' on 11-25 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3321&nmode=0&date=20251100).
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public and the gap is only 1.5 yen. The value lies only in the small chance the company acts at this print.
findings.independence: kabutan's 2025-11 archive shows the timing of last year's raise.

outside_window.finding: A further H1 and FY revision with a possible dividend raise, on last year's pattern of a November raise ahead of the H1 print.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly positive against a baseline priced_lean of -0.38 (margin overhang and run-up). The strongest positive the release could carry is a Q1 well above half of the H1 guide, which would revive 'further upside' talk as it did last year; I looked for a dividend or buyback and found none likely at this print. The strongest negative is that the September raise already moved the stock and leveraged longs are crowded.
lessons_applied: Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 may kill the event): the guide was pre-released on 9/16, though not Q1 to the yen. Cut the reported-quarter finding from +1.0 to +0.8 and abs_move_pct from 3.5 to 3.3.
Open question 4 (a run-in as a short signal was wrong once): trimmed the positioning negative from -0.8 to -0.6, because part of it rested on the run-up.
Rules 1 and 2 do not bite: no negative rests on a public series, and the set leans positive. p_up stays at 56.
